title: Marketing & Brand Associate
arrangement: Hybrid — mix of remote work and in-office days at Bashundhara R/A
desc: We're looking for a Marketing & Brand Associate to own our content, social media presence and pitch materials. You'll manage Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn pages, design brand creatives, build investor-ready pitch decks, and research potential investors and accelerators. Ideal for a final-year student or recent graduate who wants real startup experience with actual stakes.
aboutUs: Big-Matrix Solutions is an early-stage software startup building products across medical, productivity and education — the kind of software that quietly makes people's work (and lives) easier. We're small, fast-moving and building things we actually believe in. Right now, we need someone who can help the world discover what we're building — and help us tell that story well enough to bring investors on board too.
roleIntro: We're looking for a Marketing & Brand Associate to own our content, social media presence and pitch materials. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role — you won't just be posting on Instagram, you'll be shaping how Big-Matrix Solutions looks and sounds to the world, including the investors we pitch to.
roleIdeal: Ideal for: a final-year bachelor's student or recent graduate who wants real startup experience, a portfolio with actual stakes, and a resume line that says "I helped a company raise funding," not just "I managed a page."
responsibilities: Manage the company's Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn pages
Plan, create and publish engaging social media content
Design posters, banners, flyers and social media creatives that look like they belong to a real, credible brand and maintain a consistent brand identity across all platforms
Build investor-ready presentations and pitch decks — this means thinking about story and persuasion, not just slides
Research and shortlist potential angel investors, VCs and accelerators relevant to an early-stage Bangladeshi startup and help draft outreach/introduction messages
Work closely with the founding team to understand our products well enough to represent them convincingly to outsiders — including investors
requirements: Creativity with an eye for design and branding
Strong design skills (Canva, Figma, Adobe Suite — whatever you're fluent in)
Comfortable building presentations in PowerPoint / Google Slides / Canva that don't look like a school project
Good written English and an instinct for what makes content persuasive, not just visually nice
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
Genuine interest in startups, marketing or branding
Comfortable researching people/organizations and reaching out cold (investors, partners, collaborators) — or genuinely eager to learn how
niceToHave: Experience running a social media page (personal, university club, or otherwise)
Any prior exposure to pitch decks, fundraising, investor outreach or startup culture
whyJoin:
We're small on purpose, for now — which means you won't get lost in a big team. You'll work directly with the founders, see how a startup actually gets built (and pitched) and have real influence over how we look to the outside world.

If your work helps us grow — more followers that actually convert, decks that land well with investors, a brand people remember — there's real upside for you too. Strong performance means performance bonuses, a pay raise and priority consideration for a bigger, better-paid role as we grow, including after we close funding.

items: 2–3 samples of your work (design, social media, or presentations — whatever best shows what you can do)
